description: Application for a non-material amendment following a grant of planning permission ref: 14/03600/VOC (Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) of planning permission ref:- 13/03582/VOC (Demolition and redevelopment of the existing building and the erection of a part 15, part 16-24, part 19-27 storey building to provide a residential led mixed use development comprising ground floor cafe/restaurant uses (A3); office (B1); residents gym and members lounge; and 252 residential units, together with ancillary residential facilities, associated amenity space, car, motorcycle and cycle parking, access and servicing, refuse storage and collection facilities and landscaped public piazza) Planning permission is granted here pursuant to s.73 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 so as to vary condition 2 (Approved plans) of planning permission 13/03582/VOC granted on 08.11.2013  to allow for minor material amendments to the development approved under planning permission 13/03582/VOC) granted on 30.09.2014.Amendment sought:Relocation and replacement of the 18 commercial cycle parking
